name: file-card
title: File Card
description: One file as a card row: thumbnail or type icon, name, description lines and a ⋯ actions menu. A file opens the viewer, an href makes the whole card a link (a download, or a page elsewhere); UploadCard is the same row for a file uploading, with progress, Retry and Cancel.

meta.whenToUse: A record's or task's files as a list or grid of cards (put them in AttachmentGroup layout="cards" or list): a thumbnail or type icon, name, size and who/when, a ⋯ menu, opening the viewer or linking to a download or page; UploadCard for the files still uploading.
meta.whenNotToUse: A square tile grid or a scrolling strip (compose Attachment with orientation="vertical"), or a single inline chip in chat.
